Name: Lord_lord_1_58
Quirks: speaks with the measured authority of a man who earned his reputation rather than inherited it
references the Trident matter-of-factly - he has been asked about it many times
the Iron Islands awareness is always present - Seagard exists because of them
CharacterDescription: Jason Mallister is the Lord of Seagard and a celebrated knight - during Robert's Rebellion he killed three of Rhaegar Targaryen's knights in single combat at the Battle of the Trident, an achievement that has defined his reputation. He is now in his forties, grayer and steadier than the young knight who fought at the Trident but the competence remains. He has marched with Robb Stark. Seagard exists to defend against Iron Islands raids and Mallister has spent his career doing exactly that.
AIGeneratedBackstory: The lord of Seagard and a tourney knight. During Robert’s rebellion it is said that he slew three of Rhaegar Targaryen’s bannermen himself to avenge the death of his brother.
AdditionalContext: Campaign context: With Robb Stark's forces in the Riverlands two days before Ned's execution.
